articles.title: European Troops Conduct Military Exercise in Poland for Post-Ukraine War Mission
articles.description: Thousands of troops from 11 countries participate in an unprecedented two-week exercise in southeastern Poland to prepare for a potential postwar stabilization mission in Ukraine. Meanwhile, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk reported a Russian missile crash near the border, calling it a likely provocation timed to the drills.
